title: Lendflow Roundup | September
summary: This month, we’re highlighting the latest ways Lendflow is helping make lending more connected, accessible, and AI-powered. From powering Bizbe Capital’s integrated financing experience to expanding how teams can access lending data and workflows through Lendflow MCP for ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok, these updates reflect how technology is reshaping the lending ecosystem. We’re also sharing new insights on SBA lending, practical AI use cases across the lending lifecycle, and the latest industry trends and data shaping the market in 2026.
body_markdown:
###### NEWS


### What We're Excited About


### [Lendflow Partners with Bizbe to Launch Bizbe Capital](https://www.lendflow.com/post/bizbe-partners-with-lendflow-to-launch-bizbe-capital)


Bizbe has partnered with Lendflow to launch Bizbe Capital, bringing an integrated financing experience directly into its AI-native business brokerage platform. With Lendflow’s lending infrastructure and lender connectivity, Bizbe can streamline the path from diligence to financing and help qualified buyers access the capital they need to complete business acquisitions.

### [Lendflow MCP Is Now Live with ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok](https://www.lendflow.com/post/lendflow-mcp-is-now-live-on-chatgpt-claude-and-grok)


Lendflow MCP is now live on Claude and Grok, giving users more flexibility to access lending data and workflows through the AI tools they already use. Learn how expanded MCP availability is making lending operations more conversational and creating a foundation for an AI-first future.
